USAGE:
    agentskills-cli [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    add <source>    Install one or more skills from a local folder, GitHub repo,
                    git URL, or NuGet/npm package                               
    list            List installed skills grouped by agent or package           
    remove          Remove installed skills                                     
    init            Scaffold a new SKILL.md                                     
    find            Search registered providers (skills.sh and any you register)
                    and install a result                                        
    update          Check tracked skills (GitHub, GitLab, git, NuGet, npm,      
                    well-known, local) for changes and reinstall them           
    outdated        Report which tracked skills have updates available. Installs
                    nothing                                                     
    restore         Install every skill recorded in ./skills-lock.json (fresh   
                    clone, CI)                                                  
    feed            Manage the NuGet feeds used for skills                      
                    (.agents/nuget.config, ~/.agents/nuget.config)              
    registry        Manage the npm registries used for skills (.agents/.npmrc,  
                    ~/.agents/.npmrc)                                           
    version         Show the tool version, runtime, and lock file locations

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Install one or more skills from a local folder, GitHub repo, git URL, or 
NuGet/npm package

USAGE:
    agentskills-cli add <source> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <source>    Local path, GitHub shorthand (owner/repo), URL, or NuGet package
                id                                                              

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                  Prints help information                         
    -g, --global                Install to the user-wide directory instead of   
                                the project                                     
    -a, --agent <AGENTS>        Target specific agents (claude-code, codex,     
                                cursor, opencode, universal)                    
    -s, --skill <SKILLS>        Install specific skills by name. Use '*' for all
    -y, --yes                   Skip interactive prompts and accept defaults    
        --copy                  Copy files into each agent directory instead of 
                                symlinking                                      
        --symlink               Force symlink mode (default)                    
        --nuget-source <URL>    Override NuGet feed (otherwise the user's       
                                NuGet.config feeds are used)                    
        --npm-registry <URL>    Override the default npm registry (otherwise    
                                ~/.npmrc / project .npmrc + per-scope rules     
                                apply)                                          
        --as <NAME>             Install a skill under a different name, to avoid
                                a name conflict: --as <skill>=<new-name>, or    
                                just --as <new-name> when installing one skill. 
                                Repeatable                                      
        --replace               Replace existing skills from other sources that 
                                have the same name, without asking

DESCRIPTION:
List installed skills grouped by agent or package

USAGE:
    agentskills-cli list [TARGETS] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [TARGETS]    Only list skills matching these targets. Each argument is      
                 matched as a skill name first, then as a source (any shape     
                 `add` accepts). Omit to list everything                        

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help              Prints help information                             
    -g, --global            Only list globally installed skills                 
    -p, --project           Only list project-installed skills                  
    -a, --agent <AGENTS>    Limit to specific agents                            
        --by <KEY>          Group the output. Valid values: package, path,      
                            agent, scope. Default is a flat table               
        --paths             Include a column with each skill's on-disk install  
                            path                                                
        --json              Write the installed skills as JSON to stdout        
                            (ignores --by)

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Check tracked skills (GitHub, GitLab, git, NuGet, npm, well-known, local) for 
changes and reinstall them

USAGE:
    agentskills-cli update [TARGETS] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [TARGETS]    Skill names and/or sources (any shape `add` accepts:           
                 owner/repo, GitLab/git URL, NuGet or npm package id, local     
                 path). A package with @version moves to exactly that version.  
                 Omit to check everything tracked in the lock files             

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                   Prints help information                        
    -g, --global                 Limit to globally installed skills             
    -p, --project                Limit to project-installed skills              
    -a, --agent <AGENTS>         Only skills installed for these agents (and    
                                 reinstall only for them)                       
        --prerelease             Consider prerelease NuGet/npm versions         
        --version-lock <LOCK>    Limit NuGet/npm updates: none (default, any    
                                 newer version), major (stay on the current     
                                 major), minor (stay on the current major.minor)
        --json                   Write the result as JSON to stdout             
        --exit-code              When only checking: exit 1 if updates are      
                                 available, 2 if any skill could not be checked 
        --nuget-source <URL>     Check NuGet packages against this feed only    
        --npm-registry <URL>     Check npm packages against this registry       
    -y, --yes                    Install updates without prompting              
        --check                  Only report; don't install (same as `outdated`)
        --force                  Reinstall matched skills even when no change is
                                 detected

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Install every skill recorded in ./skills-lock.json (fresh clone, CI)

USAGE:
    agentskills-cli restore [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                  Prints help information                         
    -a, --agent <AGENTS>        Install for these agents. Default: detected     
                                agents (prompted when interactive)              
    -y, --yes                   Don't prompt; use every detected agent          
        --copy                  Copy files into each agent directory instead of 
                                symlinking                                      
        --force                 Reinstall skills that are already present       
        --frozen                Fail instead of installing when a source's      
                                content no longer matches the locked hash (CI)  
        --nuget-source <URL>    Restore NuGet packages from this feed only      
        --npm-registry <URL>    Restore npm packages from this registry

DESCRIPTION:
Add or update a NuGet feed for skills

USAGE:
    agentskills-cli feed add <URL> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <URL>    Feed URL (https://.../v3/index.json) or a local folder

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                            Prints help information               
    -g, --global                          Use your user file (~/.agents/...)    
                                          instead of the project's .agents/ file
    -n, --name <NAME>                     Feed name. Defaults to the host name  
                                          (or folder name for a local feed)     
    -u, --username <USER>                 Username for an authenticated feed    
                                          (user file only; needs -g)            
        --password <PASSWORD>             Password or token for an authenticated
                                          feed (user file only; needs -g)       
        --store-password-in-clear-text    Store the password unencrypted.       
                                          Required outside Windows
